notes: Only assigned unfinished fields assessed; other fields are placeholders. PDF pages 5–6 visually inspected. Year correspondence follows the explicit second-year outcome and hypothesis three, not row order or numeric matching. Known outcome mismatch retained with target_match false: source reports average university grades, whereas supplied description says math grades. Printed β retained without converting to requested unstandardized b; no unstandardized b is reported for this test and standardization is not explicitly established. Same-test p = .763 retained as context; p_r remains an unassigned placeholder. 223 + 190 + 169 = 582 participants: final mutually exclusive fixed, mixed, and growth mindset groups in Fig. 3.
